issues.quote: It removes next-morning BDC callbacks and hand-keyed outcomes, and keeps the AI out of credit.
issues.concern: I cannot say the value of this in 60 seconds. No hours, no dollars, no days, per rooftop. 'Removes callbacks' is a direction, not a number, and the BDC still enters and calls these leads the next day today. Nothing ties it to days to sale or holding cost, which is the number we say we own.
issues.ask: Put one P&L line in the TL;DR: BDC hours removed per rooftop per week (after-hours leads by type x minutes per callback, from Q15) and the lead-to-appointment days removed. If the inputs are not in hand, say 'not sized, Q15 by <date>' rather than implying removal.

issues.concern: E22 says the 3 raised an adjacent job, and one of them is a credit-app-first flow for subprime leads, which is the opposite of holding credit apps out. Counting them as the same job inflates base leverage. And none of the 3 is shown wanting write-back, so step 3 has demand from one store only.

issues.concern: Not challenging that full value is planned now. But as written, step 3 is a bespoke channel negotiated with one dealer that has an in-house system and no API. That is a one-off integration dressed as a platform step. And 'CRM-first read' means nothing for a dealer whose only feed is a forwarded ADF email.

issues.concern: We already told this dealer it was 'being worked on' with nothing behind it. Now we promise a dated plan while size and target quarter are open questions. If we hand out dates for steps 2 and 3 before engineering sizes them, we repeat the same credibility miss.
